ambient_density.label: Theorem E.12
ambient_density.statement: For fixed L, scalar L-layer MPNNs with readout are uniformly dense in the continuous real functions on the ambient DIDM space P(H^L).

realizable_compactness.label: Theorem L.2
realizable_compactness.statement: For every L>=0, the realizable bofop-DIDM image Gamma_L(BF_d^r) is compact. Only this compactness clause is used.

target.label: Theorem M.1
target.statement: For every L in N0, scalar L-layer MPNNs are uniformly dense in continuous real functions on the bofop-DIDM quotient.
